Modified portable C adaptation, 2026-11-14:
code/Main/bosch144.c, code/Main/bosch144.h, code/tests/test_bosch144.c.
Replaced C++/Arduino classes and bitfields with explicit byte masks, static
19-byte caller-owned state, compact UiSignal bytes, callback timing decoder,
and indexed envelope generation. Added half-degree Celsius controls, strict
complement/duplicate/checksum validation, atomic decode/import failure, and
bounded temperature/mode/fan button controls. No heap or full-envelope array
is used in production code. The native test loads upstream's real timing
fixture; test-only arrays are not linked into firmware.

The initial state uses the observed 25.5 C COOL / AUTO prefix:
B2 4D BF 40 C0 3F B2 4D BF 40 C0 3F D5 66 20 00 00
with REGENERATED checksum 5B. The final checksum byte was NOT physically
captured. This is a candidate state, NOT a fully received frame or hardware
compatibility claim. The incomplete 283-duration capture must not be accepted
as a verified frame. 38 kHz carrier is an upstream nominal assumption, not a
measurement. Device operation remains to be confirmed on real hardware.
